definitions.explanation: Protecting or caring for someone (especially a child) to an excessive degree, to the point where it hinders their independence or growth. Almost always carries a negative or critical nuance.

examples.japanese: {過保護|かほご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{自立|じりつ}→自立：13970_jiritsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{遅|おく}れる→遅れる：00741_okureru⟧。
examples.english: If you raise children in an overprotective way, their independence will be delayed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{心配|しんぱい}する→心配する：06066_shinpaisuru⟧{気持|きも}ち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦あまり→あまり：00604_amari⟧{過保護|かほご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よくない→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I understand the feeling of worry, but being too overprotective isn't good either.

notes:
Literally {過|か} (excessive) + ⟦{保護|ほご}→保護：03625_hogo⟧ (protection). Almost always used critically to describe parenting that goes too far. Can also be used as a noun.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過保護|かほご}な⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧ (overprotective parent)
- {過保護|かほご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧ (to raise overprotectively)
- {過保護|かほご}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be overprotective toward)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{過干渉|かかんしょう}→過干渉：21535_kakanshou⟧ — over-interfering (more about controlling behavior than shielding)
- ⟦モンスター→モンスター：12842_monsutaa⟧ペアレント — monster parent (aggressive toward schools/institutions)
- ⟦ヘリコプター→ヘリコプター：05117_herikoputaa⟧ペアレント — helicopter parent (borrowed from English)
